name: Viking 1
summary: First successful Mars landing; Chryse Planitia. Returned the first surface images and the first in-situ biology experiments. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Viking 1_bookmark" bbox (-48.268488348995625,22.0154481557824,-47.62578945100439,22.5366110442176); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Viking 2
summary: Utopia Planitia lander; imaged frost on the surface and operated for about 3.5 years. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Viking 2_bookmark" bbox (134.13864677550222,47.5431984778912,134.45999622449781,47.80377992210881); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Mars Pathfinder (Sojourner)
summary: Ares Vallis outflow plain; delivered Sojourner, the first rover on Mars. Position: centre of the Mars Trek product "sojourner_hirise_mosaic" bbox (-33.2879718,19.0227898,-33.208734,19.1598471); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Spirit (MER-A)
summary: Gusev crater rover; later climbed into the Columbia Hills. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Spirit Landing Site_bookmark" bbox (175.39293000629888,-14.744333491593578,175.62089585473169,-14.483752047375978); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Opportunity (MER-B)
summary: Meridiani Planum rover; found sulfate-rich sediments formed in water. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Opportunity Landing Site_bookmark" bbox (-5.741557185038795,-2.8465461384351998,-4.8296937913076405,-1.8042203615647998); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Phoenix
summary: Arctic lander (Vastitas Borealis); dug into and confirmed shallow water ice. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Phoenix Landing Site_bookmark" bbox (-125.9334072090411,68.0776702278912,-125.61205776004549,68.3382516721088); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Curiosity (MSL)
summary: Gale crater rover exploring Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp) layered sediments. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "Curiosity Landing Site_bookmark" bbox (136.78344100200877,-5.1083794384352,138.06883879799125,-4.0660536615647995); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: InSight
summary: Elysium Planitia lander with a seismometer and heat probe. Position: centre of the Mars Trek landing-site bookmark "InSight Landing Site_bookmark" bbox (134.75369,4.13727,136.94436,4.936); approximate site centre, accurate to the bookmark extent (~0.1-1 deg).

name: Perseverance (Mars 2020)
summary: Jezero crater rover caching samples for return to Earth; touched down at Octavia E. Butler Landing. Position: Perseverance landing coordinates 77.4509 E, 18.4446 N as specified for this project.
